Evan Miller: Hi payroll — my 3/15 paycheck is $950 lower. Looks like NY state withholding was applied but I was onsite in NJ 3/1-3/8 for customer work. NJ has lower withholding and reciprocal rules between NY/NJ might apply. Can payroll check?
Priya Narayanan: @Evan please attach a screenshot of the paystub (redact SSN) and the travel calendar entry. Also confirm whether you updated worksite form before payroll cutoff.
Evan Miller: attaching paystub snippet: Gross 5,200 | Federal 1,040 | NY state 950 | Net 3,210. Travel calendar: onsite NJ Mar 1-8. I did the one-off travel request to my manager but didn't fill the full Worksite Form.
Diego Alvarez: Quick note: our current automation uses home-state unless Worksite Form submitted or duration >=14 days for multi-state. Shorter onsite assignments default to home-state.
Evan Miller: Got it. Manager approved the visit via Slack and calendar invite. I can forward both.
Priya Narayanan: Thanks. Two things: 1) We'll open a payroll ticket for off-cycle state withholding correction if we can validate the manager approval + calendar. 2) We need confirmation you'll accept payroll-issued refund; state filing might still require you to report NY residency if you maintain primary domicile.
Evan Miller: I live in NJ now (moved last year) but some docs still show NY as home in HR because I haven't updated address after the move. I updated HR portal today.
Diego Alvarez: Important: address change after payroll cutoff won't affect the processed run. We'll need evidence of residency change (lease or NJ driver's license) to update home-state for future runs and avoid repeats. For this off-cycle, manager approval + calendar may be enough to issue an adjustment for the specific payrun; for permanent home-state switch, HR needs residency docs.
PayrollBot: Payrun processed: PRN-5017 (2026-03-15). Tax jurisdiction: NY (employee home-state flag). Automation rule: Worksite override requires WorksiteForm flag OR duration >=14d.
Priya Narayanan: Evan please DM the paystub screenshot and calendar + manager Slack confirm. Once we have that, I'll create off-cycle adj: "state withhold refund - NJ onsite" and tag Tax Ops to log potential filing impact. Typical ETA 5 business days.
Evan Miller: DM sent with docs. Also attached NJ DL scan and lease.
Priya Narayanan: Received. Creating ticket now.
PayrollBot: Ticket created: PRJ-PLY-10012 by Priya Narayanan. Off-cycle adj pending docs verification.
Diego Alvarez: We'll also update your HR home-state flag after HR verifies the NJ docs so future payruns use NJ withholding. Expect that change to apply starting next payroll cycle.
Evan Miller: Thanks team. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Priya Narayanan: We'll post back here when adj posts or Tax Ops asks for more info. :thumbsup:
